sectors.name: Għar Ħasan
sectors.description: This sector holds a great variety of boulders ranging from V0- to V4. Landings generally good due to flat ground. The entire crag is one large terrace, very hard to miss.
sectors.approach: Follow the path along the cliffs, after a tiny scramble down you will see the crag on your left.
sectors.parking: Park in the layby cat the start of a path along the cliffs down towards Ghar Hassan.

boulders.name: Għar Ħasan Terrace
boulders.description: The first terrace of boulders reached when entering the crag.

climbs.name: Walk Unafraid
climbs.description: The wall just left of the scrappy corner

climbs.name: Curl Up and Die
climbs.description: The scrappy corner

climbs.name: Cuts Both Ways
climbs.description: The diagonal crack through the overhand just right.

climbs.name: Mad Hackers
climbs.description: The overhand just right past the heart shaped scoop.

climbs.name: Wagner's Ring
climbs.description: Start at the same point as Mad Hackers, move diagonally right past the roof hole.

climbs.name: Daysleeper
climbs.description: Diagonal roof crack just right of the roof hole.

climbs.name: REM
climbs.description: Climb the right hand edge of a low buldge. A long reach for good horizontal holds.

climbs.name: Careless Whispers
climbs.description: The vertical crack 2m right on flat holds.

climbs.name: The Apologist
climbs.description: Just left of the big cave is a diagonal crack, with a sloping finish.

climbs.name: Love Path
climbs.description: Half a meter right of the crack. Start using a mono with the right hand.

climbs.name: Darklight
climbs.description: One and a half meters rights of the crack. Start using the 90 degree flake and 2 finger pocket with the right hand.

climbs.name: Dragonflight
climbs.description: From the slot move left to black flowstone then a hand traverse line left to the undercut prow, up this.

climbs.name: Point Break
climbs.description: Using the slot for the right, gain the black flowstone with the left and then the good flat hold above. Continue up.

climbs.name: Point Five
climbs.description: The easiest combination, from the slot with your right hand gain the flat hold direct with your left. Push for a jug high right. Slap up left.

climbs.name: Falls to Climb
climbs.description: Get the high jug via moves to the right of the slot.

climbs.name: The Leopard
climbs.description: Using hidden holds in the horizontal break. Dyno to a good jug up and left.

climbs.name: Firehouse
climbs.description: The overhand breached by two superb cracks. This is the left hand.

climbs.name: Up
climbs.description: Through the roof in the centre.

climbs.name: Oddfellows
climbs.description: The right hand crack.

sectors.name: Wied il-Għasel - Mosta Valley
sectors.approach: After parking next to the bus stop, cross the road via the traffic lights towards the valley. Go over the paved path and on to a dirt track, follow this down towards the base of the valley.
sectors.parking: Parking is best by the bus stop and traffic lights directly before the path down to the crag.

boulders.name: Jeff's Blocks
boulders.description: The first boulder is the large boulder in the riverbed, 150m upstream from the old bridge. The other boulders are further downstream. 'Block 5' in the topo is 10m away from 'Block 1'

topos.credit: Malta Rock Climbing - The Comprehensive Guide - 2007

climbs.name: Electra
climbs.description: Start with the left hand pinch, lunge for the small flat ledge.

climbs.name: Eternal Youth
climbs.description: Start from the finger ledge, gain the left hand pinch side-hold.

climbs.name: Third Eye
climbs.description: Pull on pockets then go for a rockover onto the slab. Intense.

climbs.name: Phantomas
climbs.description: "One of the rivers of hell, all that drank the water become forgetful of the past!"

climbs.name: Minos
climbs.description: Easily up the slab.

climbs.name: Lizard
climbs.description: Up the obvious arete and onto the easy slab above.

climbs.name: Beetle
climbs.description: Starting with a good hold, reach for the lip of the block, rockover and up the easy slab above.

climbs.name: Triton
climbs.description: Mantle the slab, trending to the right then up the easy slab above.

climbs.name: Pandora
climbs.description: Starting to the right of the grey streak using a two finger pocket, gain some crimps then direct. Delicate and requires balance.

climbs.name: Bla Ghadma (Boneless)
climbs.description: Starting just right of the obvious big grooves on big holds, then direct.

climbs.name: Sa I-Ghadma (To the bone)
climbs.description: Sit-start on good holds below the triangular hole to gain it, carry on direct up.

climbs.name: Heatwave
climbs.description: Layback the right edge of the block than knee-jam the triangular hole reaching for the obvious hold above the head.

climbs.name: Block 5 Traverse
climbs.description: Facing the block a right to left traverse, exiting up the obvious left groove.

sectors.name: Mgarr Ix-Xini (Gozo)
sectors.description: The largest sport climbing crag in Malta and Gozo also has Deep Water Solo traverse routes as well as some bouldering. A must visit for any climber.
sectors.approach: Cross the road heading towards the valley and follow a dirt track slowly down and along the edge of the cliffs. The path eventually drops down left into the valley.
sectors.parking: For bouldering approach along Triq ta' Mgarr Ix-Xini and park in a layby.

boulders.name: Hammerhead Boulder
boulders.description: Approach as for Champagne Walls sport climbing. Boulder is in the middle of the valley opposite the left hand end of the Champagne Walls.

topos.credit: Malta Rock Climbing - The Comprehensive Guide 2007

climbs.name: Mind vs Body
climbs.description: The obvious overhanding groove line (On the side of the boulder not shown by the topo)

climbs.name: The Crucifix
climbs.description: Just left of 'Mind vs Body'. Traverse left and then over the overhang. (On the side of the boulder not shown by the topo)

sectors.name: Ghajn Abdul (Gozo)
sectors.description: Great bouldering area with much untapped potential.
sectors.approach: "Drive from Rabat towards Dwejra (Inland Sea) through Gharb until just past the Ta' Dbiegi craft centre on the left. Take the first left signposted to the Kempinski San Lawrenz Resort, follow a bumpy road which leads under the escarpment. Park at a dilapidated farmhouse and water trough. The crag is up and left." - Malta Rock Climbing - A Comprehensive Guide (2007)
sectors.parking: "Park at a dilapidated farmhouse and water trough." - Malta Rock Climbing - A Comprehensive Guide (2007)

boulders.name: The Grindstone
boulders.description:
Contains the hardest boulder problem in Malta and Gozo so far.

A long boulder jacked up on the left by a small rock to form a shallow roof. From the car park, take the path leading roughly towards the center of the crag until some scattered boulders are reached. The grindstone has a round hunters hide guarding it's left side.

topos.credit: Malta Rock Climbing - The Comprehensive Guide (2007)

climbs.name: Puto Mono
climbs.description: 4m left of 'De Nada'

climbs.name: Midnight Madness
climbs.description: Traverse the lip from right to left heel hooking with your right leg for most of the route.

climbs.name: Sitstart Madness
climbs.description: Sit start variation of Midnight Madness

boulders.name: Big Brother
boulders.description: Just behind and to the right of the grindstone is the Big Brother, characterized by a sharp, overhanging arete on it's right side.

topos.credit: Malta rock Climbing - The Comprehensive Guide (2007)

boulders.name: Little Brother
boulders.description: About 300m round to the right of the Grindstone is Little Brother, a much smaller, isolated boulder, a couple of fields down from the main cliff, with just one route on it.

sectors.name: Daħlet Qorrot (Gozo)
sectors.description: Lots of potential for boulder development but only 2 boulders with recorded climbs. Very close to the beach!
sectors.approach: "Drive to Nadur. Drive along Triq it-Tigrika, following signs to San Blas. Take a left turn onto Triq San Blas as for Wied ir-Rahhan. However this time take fork right where signposted for Dahlet Qorrot and drive down Triq Dahlet Qorrot, always keeping left. Eventually one reaches a boulder spilling out onto the road on the right and a small stone hut slightly further down on the left. Park here. this area is known as il-Mixta."
